title: Real-time drift detection
subtitle: Nakiros listens to your Claude Code conversations and alerts you when a drift is detected (loop, topic shift, or saturated context). 100% local — no data is ever sent anywhere.
diffDescription: Nakiros will install two hooks (Stop + UserPromptSubmit) into your user-global Claude Code settings and write two small CJS scripts under ~/.nakiros/drift/. Review the diff and confirm.
